1 (Currently amended): An air braking unit for use in an air braking system, the air braking unit being arranged to be positioned, in use, at a vehicle wheel, and comprising: an inlet for receiving, in use, compressed air from a central source; at least one first valve arranged to selectively allow compressed air from the inlet to enter a wheel brake chamber in use; at least one second valve arranged to selectively allow air from the brake chamber to be released via an outlet to the atmosphere in use; and control means for controlling the first and second valves to operate to selectively control the air pressure in the brake chamber in use, wherein the control means is further configured to adjust the operation of the first and second valves based on feedback from one or more sensors.

2 (Currently amended): The air braking unit of claim 1, further comprising plural first valves and/or plural second valves, wherein at least one of the plural first valves and/or at least one of the plural second valves is configured to operate in response to the feedback from the one or more sensors.

3 (Currently amended): The air braking unit of claim 2, wherein the plural valves may comprise one or more larger valves arranged to allow large volumes of air to pass therethrough and one or more smaller valves arranged to allow passage of smaller volumes of air therethrough, with at least one of the larger valves and/or at least one of the smaller valves being responsive to the feedback from the one or more sensors.

4 (Currently amended): The air braking unit of claim 3, wherein the one or more smaller valves are arranged to operate at high speed, and at least one of the smaller valves is configured to adjust its operation based on the feedback from the one or more sensors.

5 (Currently amended): The air braking unit of any preceding claim, wherein one or more of the valves are driven by binary actuators, and at least one of the binary actuators is configured to receive control signals based on the feedback from the one or more sensors.

6 (Currently amended): An air braking unit according to any preceding claim, wherein the control means is arranged to receive control signals from a wheel speed sensor and an air pressure sensor for determining the pressure in the brake chamber, and is further arranged to utilize feedback from the one or more sensors to optimize the control of the first and second valves.

7 (Currently amended): An air braking unit according to claim 6, wherein the control means is arranged to receive data from a vehicle speed sensor, and reference data indicative of an optimum braking force for given vehicle and wheel speeds and control braking force based thereon, with adjustments made based on feedback from the one or more sensors.

8 (Currently amended): An air braking unit according to claim 6 or claim 7, wherein the control means is arranged to determine, from the sensors, and stored reference data, an optimum speed for each wheel and to control the braking force on each wheel in accordance with the calculated optimum speed, with adjustments made based on feedback from the one or more sensors.

9 (Currently amended): An air braking system comprising one or more units according to any preceding claim; a pump for generating compressed air; and a central compressed air storage tank, wherein the system is configured to optimize braking performance based on feedback from the one or more sensors.
